title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting the foundation of a progressive nation's strength and power
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam today, highlighting that the strength and power of a progressive nation are founded upon penance, religious observances, and the desire for the welfare of all. The Prime Minister wrote on X; "भद्रमिच्छन्त ऋषयः स्वर्विदस्तपो दीक्षामुपनिषेदुरग्रे। ततो राष्ट्रं बलमोजश्च जातं तदस्मै देवा उपसन्नमन्तु॥" The sages, who wished for the welfare of all and were knowledgeable about heaven, first devoted themselves to penance and religious observances. It was through this penance and these observances that the nation, strength, and power came into existence. All the gods pay homage to such a progressive nation and its strength. भद्रमिच्छन्त ऋषयः स्वर्विदस्तपो दीक्षामुपनिषेदुरग्रे। 

ततो राष्ट्रं बलमोजश्च जातं तदस्मै देवा उपसन्नमन्तु॥ https://t.co/hSi37V0Dcs — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 11, 2026 *** MJPS/SS/PRK
